meanings.note: Больной ребёнок = a sick child. Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('sick, ill; (as a noun) patient').

meanings.note: Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'спаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'get enough sleep'.
